statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-46680 is a type-confusion bug in containerd's parsing of a container's numeric User directive at container launch, allowing a crafted image's /etc/passwd to bypass runAsNonRoot. The harbor-trivy-adapter image includes the upstream trivy binary (from dhi/trivy) which vendors github.com/containerd/containerd and .../v2 only for image inspection (pulling, unpacking, and parsing OCI manifests/layers during vulnerability scanning). Trivy does not launch containers and never invokes containerd's user-resolution code path, so the vulnerable code is not reachable in this image. The image's own scanner-trivy binary already pins containerd@v1.7.32 (fixed). Will pick up the fix in trivy automatically when dhi/trivy bumps its containerd dependency.
